behavior: AC1 — the plan gives every retire a verdict and prints no value
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ ./internal/secrets/ -run '^TestVerifyRetiresGivesEachRetireAVerdict$|^TestReconcilePlanShowsEachRetireVerdict$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 2

behavior: AC2 — a retire that is not equal blocks and names how to settle it; apply re-verifies with the same exits
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/secrets/ -run '^TestVerifyRetiresNamesHowToSettleEachBlocker$|^TestApplyRetireRefusalNamesTheExits$|^TestApplyRetireRefusesWhenTheValuesDiffer$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 3

behavior: AC3 — the registry validates retired: entries, including an item a declaration still names
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/secrets/ -run '^TestRegistryValidatesRetiredItems$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 1

behavior: AC4 — a retired item is planned with its shape, deleted by id on both backends, and reported gone
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ ./internal/secrets/ -run '^TestPlanRetiredItems$|^TestApplyDeletesARetiredItem$|^TestBWServeWriter_DeleteItem$|^TestBWPut_DeleteItemDeletesByID$|^TestReconcileDeletesARetiredItem$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 5

behavior: AC5 — a retired name that matches several items blocks
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/secrets/ -run '^TestPlanRetiredItems$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 1

behavior: AC6 — no planted value reaches any new plan, apply or error output
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/cmd/ ./internal/secrets/ -run '^TestVerifyRetiresGivesEachRetireAVerdict$|^TestApplyRetireRefusalNamesTheExits$|^TestReconcilePlanShowsEachRetireVerdict$|^TestReconcileDeletesARetiredItem$' -count=1 -v | grep -c '^--- PASS:' | grep -qx 4
